newsitem.title: USA: Tengasco says court upholds 1996 judgment.
newsitem.headline: Tengasco says court upholds 1996 judgment.

text.p: Tengasco Inc said Wednesday the Court of Appeals of Tennessee upheld a Sept. 10, 1996 judgment in its favor and in the favor of landowners Paul and Lucille Reed.
The 1996 judgment was made by the Circuit Court for Hancock County, Tenn.

The company said the appellate court ruled that its lease on the 647 acres owned by the Reeds was valid, and Eastern American Energy Corp's 1979 lease had terminated for failure to produce oil and gas from the lands.
The company said the court based its ruling on the Tennessee statute which sets a maximum term for oil and gas leases at 10 years on lands where no oil or gas is being produced.
